name: Flohschanze
facts: flea and antiques market, no new goods
open-air pitches plus covered pavilions and hall space, runs in any weather
opposite U-Bahnhof Feldstraße in the Karolinenviertel
leftover pitches given out on site 07:00–08:30
free parking at Glacischaussee, 5 minutes on foot
notes: Dates page lists every Saturday to 19 Dec 2026; 26 Dec is not listed (public holiday) and no 2027 dates are published yet, so January is empty. Organiser dates page is a calendar-year list (its "Januar 03.01.2026" entries are last January, not 2027). Entry fee not stated. Market info page is /index.php?p=59&var=0.

description.de: Jeden Samstag von 8 bis 16 Uhr gegenüber dem U-Bahnhof Feldstraße im Karolinenviertel. Floh- und Antikmarkt ohne Neuware, auf freien Plätzen, unter Pavillons und in der Halle, bei jedem Wetter. Restplätze werden ab 7 Uhr vor Ort vergeben; kostenlose Parkplätze an der Glacischaussee, fünf Minuten zu Fuß.
description.en: Every Saturday from 8 to 4 opposite U-Bahn Feldstraße in the Karolinenviertel. A flea and antiques market with no new goods, on open pitches, under pavilions and in the hall, whatever the weather. Leftover pitches are handed out on site from 7; free parking on Glacischaussee, five minutes on foot.
